name: Default
shortDescription: Ungoogled Chromium browser, Chromium without Google web service integration, streamed to your own browser behind a password, with profiles, extensions and downloads kept on a persistent volume.

alerts.message: Sign in with the CUSTOM_USER and PASSWORD values from the environment. This basic auth is the only protection, and anyone who signs in gets a terminal with passwordless sudo inside the container.
HTTPS is required; the streamed browser does not work over plain HTTP.
